So where do I find my free ship? It says that I have to buy a ship and everything is still cost money. What do I do?

• Enter your hangar (aka boot up the game)

  • You should see something that resembles an oval pod. This is your SimPod. Walk up to it and get in it (I think you press F)

  • From there you can launch Arena Commander. The ship from the promotion (the F7C hornet) should be available as an option.

Alternatively, I think you can get to Arena Commander from the esc key menu. Try using a button that says 'Electronic Access' if AC isn't immediately visible.
